titleEn: Number of Subarrays With LCM Equal to K
title: 最小公倍数为 K 的子数组数目
summary: 统计最小公倍数恰等于 k 的连续非空子数组数量。
insight: 固定左端点向右扩展并维护当前 LCM。LCM 只会保持或增大；一旦它不再是 k 的约数，继续加入元素也不可能回到 k，可立即停止。
pitfalls: 更新 LCM 时先除 gcd 避免无谓放大
当前 LCM 不整除 k 后可以剪枝

solutions.title: 枚举左端点并滚动计算 LCM
solutions.idea: 利用整除关系提前终止每次右扩。
steps: 对每个 left 初始化 lcm=1
若 lcm==k 则答案加一

code.java: class Solution { private long gcd(long a,long b){while(b!=0){long remainder=a%b;a=b;b=remainder;}return a;}public int subarrayLCM(int[] nums,int k){int answer=0;for(int left=0;left<nums.length;left++){long lcm=1;for(int right=left;right<nums.length;right++){lcm=lcm/gcd(lcm,nums[right])*nums[right];if(lcm>k||k%lcm!=0)break;if(lcm==k)answer++;}}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun gcd(aValue:Long,bValue:Long):Long{var a=aValue;var b=bValue;while(b!=0L){val remainder=a%b;a=b;b=remainder};return a}fun subarrayLCM(nums:IntArray,k:Int):Int{var answer=0;for(left in nums.indices){var lcm=1L;for(right in left..nums.lastIndex){lcm=lcm/gcd(lcm,nums[right].toLong())*nums[right];if(lcm>k||k.toLong()%lcm!=0L)break;if(lcm==k.toLong())answer++}};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { long long gcd(long long a,long long b){while(b){long long remainder=a%b;a=b;b=remainder;}return a;}public:int subarrayLCM(vector<int>& nums,int k){int answer=0;for(int left=0;left<(int)nums.size();++left){long long lcm=1;for(int right=left;right<(int)nums.size();++right){lcm=lcm/gcd(lcm,nums[right])*nums[right];if(lcm>k||k%lcm)break;if(lcm==k)++answer;}}return answer;} };
